kill_switch.comment: OFF by default. Mock source is a no-op until explicitly enabled. Real adapters (ETW/FIM/RegNotify) will respect the same kill switch.

replay.comment: tick_ns = 1ms between events by default. jitter_ns > 0 adds random delay for stress tests. loop_on_exhausted=true replays scenario forever (load testing).
